summary.name: AFFiNE
summary.one_liner: AFFiNE is an open-source, local-first knowledge base workspace that combines docs, whiteboards, databases, and optional AI.
use_cases: build an internal team knowledge base
document decisions in a connected wiki
turn ideas into slides for presentations
summary.what_it_does: AFFiNE is a workspace that merges docs, whiteboards, and databases in one place. Content is built from blocks in a write-focused editor, and a separate canvas handles drawing, diagramming, and mind mapping. Planning features cover project tasks and databases. The page describes optional AI workflows and templates. It positions itself as local-first and privacy-focused, meaning users keep control over their data.
notable: Docs, whiteboards, and databases in one local-first workspace
MIT-licensed editor, per the meta description
caveats: Free for individuals; commercial and team usage fees apply
Self-hosting is free only up to 10 seats per workspace, per the meta description
